protocol: FARS Reversal V1 / C1 desde el dia 1

primary_configuration.displacement_definition: current M5 high-low range >= disp_mult * mean high-low range of the 20 preceding closed M5 bars; same declared calculation used by crt4h
primary_configuration.target: nearest active opposite-side liquidity/session pool beyond entry
primary_configuration.stop: far extreme of swept pool/sweep bar plus sl_buffer_pts
primary_configuration.pending_limit_invalidation: close back through the structure level before fill

walk_forward.purge: real trade intervals at fold boundaries
walk_forward.selection: none; all configurations are frozen and test windows are evaluative only

cost_scenarios_in_order.slippage_scope: STOP and MARKET/time exits; LIMIT and TP do not slip
crossing orders only; LIMIT and TP do not slip

reading_criterion: Report E[R] and PF together for baseline, each individual optional filter, their combination, and the declared market-entry neighbor. Any incomplete run or fold with inadequate observations is evidencia_insuficiente. No configuration is promoted by this protocol.
